top_choice_rationale: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics is a single dated 1985 two-author step that was completely new: electrons and nuclei propagated together so bond breaking, proton transfer and condensed-phase reactions are computed without a fitted force field. Four decades of independent use give it real consequences, the allocation to Car and Parrinello leaves no priority dispute under the three-laureate limit, and the citation can be confined to the 1985 unification, distinct from the 2013 multiscale and 2024 structure-prediction prizes. Ionizable lipid nanoparticles (P002) rank second for larger impact but have an unsettled three-name cut; Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (P003) is mature and cleanly attributed but follows the 2010 cross-coupling prize; no award is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a simulation specialist and may overvalue theory, but no personal tie to Car or Parrinello is recorded.
